text:
Ravi (AE): Heads-up — Helios Biotech procurement sent back an MSA + DPA with multiple redlines. They want: 1) BYOK/HSM addendum; 2) 7-year audit logs retention; 3) choice of law = Germany; 4) PO net45 referencing sku. Need quick alignment so we can send for signature. Who can own next steps?

Marta (Legal): Please upload their marked MSA/DPA. Initial read: 7 years is non-starter. We typically do 1 year for logs; can offer 3 years for regulated healthcare after escalation. Choice of law: we can accept EU jurisdiction but prefer a neutral venue. BYOK addendum: we have a template but need to confirm key custody and interface (PKCS#11 vs cloud KMS).

Ola (Finance): Net45 ok for enterprise but we need the PO to include specific bill-to and the negotiated line item (dedicated-poc-monthly sku). Also need VAT ID and whether they require reverse charge. If they want invoice referencing HSM professional services, that should be a separate line item for SOW.

Tanner (Solutions): Tech note: EU data residency is fine but provisioning private pool + HSM will add setup SOW and a small license uplift. If they expect SOC2 + last pentest, we can share under NDA; else provide summary. Also confirm SSO / SAML requirements — provisioning will wait for a technical contact.

Ravi (AE): Uploading the redlines now. Procurement contact is lena@helios.io. They said signer will be Director Procurements and a legal countersign. They asked for single exec signature on Redwood side to speed things up.

ContractsBot: Drafted envelope env_0xC3D4. Default Redwood signers: "Legal Director" and "Chief Revenue Officer". To use single exec signer set approver to "CRO".

Marta (Legal): We can allow CRO-only if Contracts team confirms authority delegation. I'll prep a tracked-change response to DPA and propose audit retention = 3 years and explicit HSM addendum language. Flagging indemnity/limitation edits — we should push back on any expansion of liability.

Ola (Finance): Also need PO number format for AR system. Sampler PO example we accept: 
```
PO#: HB-PO-2026-045
Bill-to: Redwood Inference Inc.
Line items:
- Dedicated-Pool (POC) 3 months - sku: RED-DED-POC-M
- HSM BYOK provisioning - sku: RED-HSM-SETUP
```
Include billing email and VAT ID.

ApprovalsBot: CRO approval required for any MSA with exceptions > standard limits. Please request pre-approval if using single signer.

Tanner (Solutions): Next steps from me: create SOW draft with timeline (2-3 weeks provisioning), list cert exchange formats (PEM/PFX) and recommend PKCS#11 for HSM. If they insist on on-prem appliance, note ~50% uplift and add eng effort line.

Ravi (AE): Proposed quick timeline: today upload redline + PO; Marta to send redline response by EOD; ContractsBot to queue envelope for signatures once legal signoff; Ola to confirm invoicing flow and tax checklist. Can we aim to get signed PO + envelope out by Friday?

Marta (Legal): I'll push back on 7 years and propose 3, attach KMS addendum template, and include SOC2 sharing under one-way NDA. If customer refuses 3 years we escalate to CCO.

Ola (Finance): I'll verify VAT handling with AR and confirm if we need their W-8/W-9.

ContractsBot: Envelope env_0xC3D4 updated with attachments: Redwood MSA (response version), KMS Addendum, Draft Order Form. Waiting on signer list confirmation.

Ravi (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll ping Lena for PO with the sku lines and ask if technical lead can join the onboarding sync. @ApprovalsBot requesting CRO pre-approval for single-signer flow to speed up.

ApprovalsBot: Pre-approval request submitted to CRO queue (req_778). Expected SLA: 24 hours.

Tanner (Solutions): Adding one more note — customer asked about export controls due to biotech data. We need security to confirm allowed processing. Tagging security will be necessary if they insist on restricted processing.

Marta (Legal): Noted. For now I'll include a carveout request and recommend we request specific data classification from Helios. See you all in the 2pm sync if needed. :white_check_mark:
